query: SELECT schemaname,tablename,indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='library_documents' ORDER BY indexname

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_bibliographic_metadata ON public.library_documents USING gin (bibliographic_metadata)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_collection_id ON public.library_documents USING btree (collection_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_doc_code ON public.library_documents USING btree (knowledge_scope_id, document_code) WHERE (document_code IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_language ON public.library_documents USING btree (language)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_metadata ON public.library_documents USING gin (metadata)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_org ON public.library_documents USING btree (organization_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_project ON public.library_documents USING btree (project_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_scope ON public.library_documents USING btree (knowledge_scope_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_source_sha256 ON public.library_documents USING btree (source_sha256)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_status ON public.library_documents USING btree (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_title_lower ON public.library_documents USING btree (lower(title))
CREATE INDEX ix_library_documents_ws ON public.library_documents USING btree (workspace_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX library_documents_pkey ON public.library_documents USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_library_documents_scope_collection_sha256 ON public.library_documents USING btree (knowledge_scope_id, collection_id, source_sha256) WHERE (knowledge_scope_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_library_documents_unscoped_collection_sha256 ON public.library_documents USING btree (collection_id, source_sha256) WHERE (knowledge_scope_id IS NULL)
